<!-- pr-reviewer: 97c754f5f121a529b3439ac1a8c871856f44202c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #2279, see "Stack" below).

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes which operation kinds generate and post in an aligned setup, and the frame that Slot picks use.

### What looks good
- `setup_align::verified_kind` adds six kinds. The refusal message lists the same kinds.
- `slot_bound_of`, `confine_slot` and `slot_from_picks` get the setup from each caller. The callers are `CreateOperation`, `SetOperationGeometry`, `collect_job`, `region_for` and `slot_fit_of`. Each caller gives the setup of the operation, not the active setup.
- In an unaligned setup, `setup_align::pose_in` gives the model pose. Thus the old path does not change. The existing slot suites stay green.
- Detect holes and the external-thread boss list read `material_of(world, setup, src)`. Thus they already read the setup frame.
- The new test file has a provenance line and a Gate map. It is under 400 lines.
- The decision file has the second section, with the kinds that stay refused and their issues (#2283-#2287).
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in new non-test code. No new dependency. No process file. No UI change, so no screenshots are necessary.

### Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `3701b32d8`)
- Build: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run`: OK.
- Touched suites:
  - `setup_align_hole_kinds`: 4 passed
  - `setup_align_2d_kinds`: 8 passed
  - `setup_align`: 10 passed
  - `opframe_picks`: 4 passed
  - `slot_pick_refusals`: 3 passed
  - `slot_picks`: 8 passed
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (this includes the #2279 diff): 45 of 46 steps OK. `keep_law` failed. See "Notes": the same failure occurs on upstream/main without this PR.
- Clippy `-D warnings` on the `camcraft-app` lib and the six touched test targets: clean.

### Mutations (local only, not pushed)
1. `slot_pick::slot_bound_of` reads `model::transform_of` again (the model frame). Result: RED. `turned_picked_slot_fills_the_turned_face` fails.
2. `material::holes_of` recognises holes on the world facets (the model frame), not on the setup facets. Result: RED. All 4 tests of `setup_align_hole_kinds` fail.
3. Probe of the opposite direction of the stale-list test: a hole list detected As modelled on an upright-hole plate, then the setup turned 90 degrees about X, with a shallow drill depth. Result: generation marks `Gouge` and `RapidInStock`, and the post is blocked ("post blocked - gouge: program cuts below the model in 399 cell(s)"). The stale list does not post silently. With the full depth, the flute-reach check refuses at the command.

No goldens move in this PR.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Stack
- The base of this PR is `issue/2276-aligned-setup-kinds` (#2279). Retarget this PR to `main` before #2279 merges (`gh pr edit 2288 --base main`).
- After the retarget, merge `origin/main` into the branch and run the quick gate again.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `keep_law` fails in the trial merge in 6 `*_turned` cases (3 `pocket`, 3 `adaptive`). The 3 `pocket_turned` cases fail the same way on upstream/main `3701b32d8` without this PR. I did not run the `adaptive_turned` cases on main, because each takes more than 60 s. The post is still refused. Only the assert at `crates/app/tests/keep_law.rs:148` fails: the refusal leads with the program-sim gouge, not with the `P1: move ... cuts past the finish surface` clause.
- The test target `stock_in_vise_sim` does not compile on upstream/main `3701b32d8`: `missing field 'body' in initializer of 'LocateSpec'`. Thus `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets` fails on main. This PR does not touch it.
- `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs` has 412 lines (406 on main). Split it at the next change.
- Not exercised by the tests (the PR body says so too): an external Thread on bosses in a turned setup, and Circular or Trochoidal Slot from picks.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
